help:
usage: gnd export [-h]
                  {souffle,souffle-verify,souffle-run,souffle-witness,lean,lean-verify,lean-compile,pyrel} ...

positional arguments:
  {souffle,souffle-verify,souffle-run,souffle-witness,lean,lean-verify,lean-compile,pyrel}
    souffle             bounded standalone Souffle derivation claim
    souffle-verify      bounded standalone Souffle derivation claim
    souffle-run         bounded standalone Souffle derivation claim
    souffle-witness     bounded standalone Souffle derivation claim
    lean                finite Lean definitions; explicit unproved obligations
    lean-verify         finite Lean definitions; explicit unproved obligations
    lean-compile        finite Lean definitions; explicit unproved obligations
    pyrel               export a standalone PyRel program

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
